# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported |
| :--- | :--- |
| `1.x` | Yes |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please **do not** report security vulnerabilities (such as credential exposure, PIN handling bugs, or command injection issues) through public GitHub issues.

Instead, report vulnerabilities privately through **[GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting](https://github.com/misraaks/homebridge-subarulink/security/advisories/new)** on this repository.

When reporting an issue, never include real MySubaru credentials, 4-digit PINs, session files (`subarulink.cfg`), or vehicle VINs.
